bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd "$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot/.worktrees/video-two-topic-20261124"
set +e
docker build -q -f artifacts/bot/deploy/Dockerfile.gaybbs -t gace-video-two-topic-pins:20261124 . >/tmp/video-two-build-v2.log 2>&1
res=$?
set -e
if test "$res" -eq 0; then exit 0; fi
log=/tmp/video-two-build-v2.log
if grep -Eiq 'network|fetch|ECONN|ETIMEOUT|TLS|certificate' "$log"; then exit 81; fi
if grep -Eiq 'ERR_PNPM_OUTDATED_LOCKFILE|frozen-lockfile' "$log"; then exit 82; fi
if grep -Eiq 'ERR_PNPM|pnpm install|npm ERR|npm error' "$log"; then exit 83; fi
if grep -Eiq 'Could not resolve|No matching export|build failed|error:' "$log"; then exit 84; fi
if grep -Eiq 'permission denied|Docker daemon' "$log"; then exit 85; fi
exit 86
